args.stdin: SELECT s.store_id, s.record_path, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pv.product_sku) FROM product_variants pv JOIN store_inventory si ON pv.product_sku = si.product_sku AND si.store_id = s.store_id WHERE si.available_today_quantity >= 4 AND ((pv.brand = 'Festool' AND pv.series = 'Modular CTL' AND pv.model = 'XPW-76I' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'storage_type' AND property_value_text = 'tool bag') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'color_family' AND property_value_text = 'Yellow')) OR (pv.brand = 'Gorilla' AND pv.series = 'Crystal Grip' AND pv.model = '2ZQ-D83' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'adhesive_type' AND property_value_text = 'epoxy')) OR (pv.brand = 'Wiha' AND pv.series = 'VDE' AND pv.model = '13X-B49' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'tool_profile' AND property_value_text = 'pozidriv')) OR (pv.brand = 'Festool' AND pv.series = 'Modular CTL' AND pv.model = 'XPW-76I' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'storage_type' AND property_value_text = 'tool box')) OR (pv.brand = 'Sika' AND pv.series = 'Professional' AND pv.model = '28T-UV8' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'sealant_type' AND property_value_text = 'silicone sealant') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'color_family' AND property_value_text = 'Black')) OR (pv.brand = '3M' AND pv.series = 'Ventilated SecureFit' AND pv.model = '2CE-B35' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = pv.product_sku AND property_key = 'lens_color' AND property_value_text = 'Yellow')))) AS cnt FROM stores s WHERE s.store_name = 'Ljubljana Center Power Tool store'
